title: City Council Special Meeting
motion: to suspend the rules and set December 10, 2024, at 6:00 PM as the Deadline for Individuals to Submit Their Names for Consideration to Fill the Vacancy of the Office of the Mayor and that we Schedule a Council Meeting on December 10, 2024, at 6 PM at Midvale City Hall to Interview qualified Candidates and Appoint a Candidate to Fill the Vacant Office of Mayor
